# ETHPayServer

> A self-hosted, non-custodial Ethereum and EVM-chain payment processor.
> Merchants register an extended public key (xpub); the server derives
> payment addresses from it and never holds a spending key, so it cannot
> move merchant funds and cannot recover a lost key.

This is self-hosted software distributed as a git repository, not a single
hosted product — there is no one canonical instance URL. Replace
`https://your-instance.example.com` in the guide below with the host a
given deployment actually runs on.

## Docs

- [Merchant API Integration Guide](https://github.com/gcannelloni/ethpayserver/blob/main/docs/merchant-api-guide.md): The single page for integrating — authentication, store and wallet setup, payment methods, invoices, webhooks, checkout, error handling, and a full worked example. Read this first and in full before writing an integration; it is written to be complete on its own.

## Machine-readable

- OpenAPI 3 spec, generated from the server's own request/response types (never hand-written, so it cannot drift from the API): served at `GET /api-docs/openapi.json` on any running instance with `ENABLE_SWAGGER=true` (the server's own default), interactive form at `GET /swagger-ui`. Prefer it over the guide above for exact field names, types, and optionality.

## Explicit constraints

- Amounts are JSON strings, never numbers, and use base units (e.g. wei) for on-chain values but decimal currency units for invoice-level totals — see "Critical constraints" in the guide above before writing any amount-handling code.
- The server never sends a transaction in the shipped build (a signing/broadcasting module exists behind an off-by-default `hot-wallet` Cargo feature that no binary here enables — see `evm/README.md`). The refund endpoint always refuses (501) and creates nothing — refunding is the merchant's job, from the wallet that holds the spending key. The payout endpoint records intent only. See "What ETHPayServer Does Not Do" in the guide above.
- Webhook delivery is at-least-once; dedupe on `idempotency_key`, not `event_id`.
